label: Unity Ads
terms_note: Unity Grow (Acquire) advertiser organization; API key from the dashboard (Organization → API management — TODO(verify)); Campaign Management API + Statistics API under docs.unity.com. Rate limits: not read. Free.

discovery.auth: api_key (Unity Grow organization API key; Bearer)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Acquire campaign management + statistics REST APIs).
auth: 1. Unity Grow organization → API key (Organization API management).

fields.name: key_id
fields.help: Key ID of a Unity service account (Unity Cloud dashboard > Administration > Service accounts) with an Advertise API role (Viewer for reads, Campaigns Editor or Admin for budget changes); the HTTP Basic username.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The service account's secret key, the HTTP Basic password.

config_fields.name: organization_id
config_fields.help: Unity organization id (core id) that owns the Unity Ads advertiser apps; part of every path.

config_fields.name: campaign_set_id
config_fields.help: App (campaign set) id used by update_budget, since budget calls are addressed as /apps/{campaignSetId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/budget. Take it from list_accounts.

me.note: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /advertise/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/apps?limit=1, which verifies the service account and its Advertise role on the organization.

list_accounts.note: GET /apps: the organization's advertised apps (campaign sets). Unity Ads groups campaigns per app, so each app `id` (campaignSetId) is what list_campaigns takes as account_id. Budgets are in USD.

list_campaigns.note: GET /apps/{campaignSetId}/campaigns[?filter[enabled]=true|false]: the app's campaigns. status accepts active/enabled (enabled=true) or paused/disabled (enabled=false); the `enabled` boolean is returned in its own field (no string status exists). Budgets are a separate resource (GET …/campaigns/{campaignId}/budget), so `budget` is not mapped. `page`/`limit` are not sent.

update_budget.note: PATCH /apps/{campaign_set_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/budget {daily: "<USD, up to 2 decimals>"} (a partial update: the total budget is unchanged; 0 disables the daily cap). This spends money. Unity recommends at least $500 per country daily for CPI campaigns. Campaigns using per-country daily budgets (dailyPerCountry) are not changed by this call. Needs the campaign_set_id config field (the app the campaign belongs to). `currency` is ignored (USD).

pause_resume.note: PATCH /apps/{campaign_set_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id} {"enabled": false|true} (a partial campaign update). Needs the campaign_set_id config field (the app the campaign belongs to). Unity limits updates to one per second and 100 per 30 minutes per campaign.

not_offered.get_report: Acquisition statistics come from the separate Advertising Statistics API, which returns CSV ('retrieve acquisition statistics data in a CSV format', https://docs.unity.com/en-us/grow/acquire/management/acquire-rest-apis); the runtime reads JSON only.

evidence: host services.api.unity.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
